promotion_rule: A challenger becomes champion only after a 4-seed, 20-dataset run under the strict 3-shot protocol where all four macro metrics are strictly better than the current champion's 4-seed macro; at least 3/4 seeds must be not worse on Dice/IoU/clDice, and HD95 must be not worse in at least 3/4 seeds. Selection must be validation-only; no target labels, target images, test-time adaptation, or protocol changes. A 3/4 win is recorded as a challenger, not champion.
resolution_rule: When the user says 当前最强模型 / 当前冠军 / CURRENT_BEST / champion, read this file first. Do not rely on memory or old model names. If the file is missing or stale, stop and ask.
